description: Who holds this Arc token, and did the creator pull the liquidity? Holder count, top 10 holders and top 10 ordinary wallets with % of supply, what the Uniswap v4 pools hold now, the creator (launch transaction sender) with what they hold, put into pools and took back, their other launches in 30 days, and plain-sentence flags. History proven complete; tokens older than about 2 days are refused before payment. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_holders
